text:
When choosing a career, some graduates dream of joining a famous corporation, while others prefer a small local firm, and opinions differ on which offers the better working life. This essay will consider both views before explaining my own opinion.

On the one hand, supporters of large corporations argue that they offer security and benefits. Big companies pay well, train staff and rarely collapse, and they offer clear promotion paths and international opportunities. A young engineer who joins a global company, for example, may receive expensive training and the chance to work abroad. Large firms also provide health insurance, pensions and paid holidays, and a well-known name on a curriculum vitae opens doors later. Departments in a big firm also let staff move between roles without changing employer, which keeps careers interesting over many years. For people who value stability, particularly those with families, this is a strong argument.

On the other hand, advocates of small businesses point out that they offer variety and closer relationships. Employees can feel like small cogs in a large company, whereas small businesses give wider responsibility, faster promotion and a friendly atmosphere. A graduate in a small design studio, for example, may handle clients, budgets and creative work within a year. Decisions are made quickly, and ideas from staff are more likely to be heard. The disadvantages are lower pay, fewer benefits and less stability, since small firms can fail during a recession.

In conclusion, both views have merit. Overall, I believe that the best choice depends on personality and career stage: a large corporation suits those who need security, while a small business suits those who want to learn quickly and to take responsibility.

Lương cao, đào tạo, ít sụp đổ; lộ trình thăng tiến, cơ hội quốc tế; ví dụ kỹ sư trẻ được đào tạo, làm ở nước ngoài; bảo hiểm, lương hưu, tên tuổi trong CV; hợp người cần ổn định.

Đa dạng và quan hệ gần gũi: trách nhiệm rộng, thăng tiến nhanh, không khí thân thiện; ví dụ sinh viên ở studio nhỏ lo khách hàng, ngân sách trong một năm; quyết định nhanh, ý kiến được nghe; nhược: lương thấp, ít phúc lợi, dễ thất bại.
Tuỳ tính cách và giai đoạn nghề.
